detail.longDescription:
Hi everyone, I am new to self-hosting and this is also my first post on Lemmy. I
have a navidrome instance for my music (installed via docker compose) and a
jellyfin instance for movies and shows (also installed via docker compose)
running on a Raspberry Pi 4 8GB. I know I could also use music over jellyfin but
I prefer to have it in navidrome. The next thing that I want to achieve on my
journey through the world of self-hosting is to run my own matrix server. The
ideal eventual goal would be to have my own server on that same Raspberry Pi
which I can then use to bridge Whatsapp to so I finally can get rid of that App
from my primary phone. Receiving Whatsapp messages is unfortunately necessary
for me to keep contact with certain people, although I would prefer to get rid
of it completely as well, but who am I telling that, there are plenty of people
out there facing the same issue. As Whatsapp needs to run somewhere, which is
required to have the bridge properly working, it would ideally run in an Android
Virtual Device although that is no requirement as I know physical phones are
recommended and emulated devices get blocked more often. Ideally, the matrix
server would also be installed using docker compose. It is intended to have one
user only which is me but should of course be able to communicate with other
servers to enable me to talk to others. The main limitation is that all three
services should be running on that Raspberry Pi at the same time. As my
experience regarding such a project is virtually zero, my questions are: Is such
a setup is feasible and generally a good or bad idea (considering running
jellyfin, navidrome and matrix on one Raspberry Pi)? What issues should I
consider before starting such a project? If there’s someone having a similar
setup, what are your experiences? Also important to note: The matrix server
should be able to handle video and voice calls as well, not in large rooms of
course, but rather in a context of 2 to 4 people max. Any advice, information or
personal experience is well appreciated! I want to properly inform myself before
starting out and thought here might be a good starting point. If I forgot to
mention any specific information that is needed please let me know. Thanks a
lot! EDIT: Adjusted post title to better reflect the advise-seeking character of
this post and adjusted question phrasing
